column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the Qere “loose yourself” (Kethiv “they have loosed”).
Close to the Hebrew; “you were sold” is rendered “You have sold yourselves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sojourn” is rendered “dwell,” and “for nothing” “without cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; “rulers wail” is rendered “Those who rule over them Make them wail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “here I am” is rendered “Behold, it is I.”
Close to the Hebrew; “bears news good” is rendered “brings glad tidings of good things.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when Yahweh returns to Zion” is rendered “When the LORD brings back Zion.”
NKJV capitalizes “My Servant,” and “will prosper” is rendered “shall deal prudently.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a disfigurement from a man” is rendered “His visage was marred more than any man.”
NKJV renders יַזֶּה (“startle” or “sprinkle,” yazzeh) as “sprinkle,” and capitalizes “He” and “Him.”
